headline: SpaceX acquires spectrum to become major mobile carrier via Starlink
summary: SpaceX has acquired low-band spectrum licenses, including nationwide 800 MHz frequencies, aiming to turn its Starlink Mobile service into a major US cell carrier pending FCC approval. Low-band spectrum could extend indoor coverage, part of a push outlets frame as challenging AT&T, T-Mobile, and Verizon.

claims.statement: SpaceX has acquired low-band spectrum licenses to turn Starlink Mobile into a major US mobile carrier.
